_about: Gold dataset for extraction evaluation. Each case is a realistic, ANONYMISED free-text self-description (any language) with hand-labelled expected CV fields. Used by run_extraction_eval.py to compute field-level precision/recall/F1 so any model/prompt/pipeline change can be measured objectively. Add more cases over time (target ~100). Scalar fields are matched normalised+fuzzy; list fields use set P/R/F1 with relaxed matching.

experiences: substrings/keywords that MUST appear in an experience entry
education: keywords that must appear in an education entry
